insights: Carnival's superior returns come entirely from lower costs; its revenue per passenger matches its rival's.
The operating cost gap lies in transportation and port charges, likely from short drive-to Caribbean sailings.
Lower capital per berth stems from an older fleet and denser ships, not cheaper ship purchases.
Maximum acquisition price should equal capacity value plus operating cost savings capitalised at an EV/EBIT multiple.
Industry attractiveness, five forces and strategic frontier analysis should frame acquisition logic before firm-level evaluation.
Running GPU workloads inside VMs, as some neoclouds do, may cost meaningful performance versus bare metal.
High-quality general pretraining outperforms domain-specific robotics post-training, extending the bitter lesson to robotics.
Robotics foundation model companies build on existing large models and add their own robot-specific post-training.
RT-2's key contribution was co-training robot fine-tuning data alongside the original pretraining data.
Arm stability and grasp control remain open engineering problems that scaled VLA models do not resolve.

ideas.summary: Human video as robot training data
insights: Scarce real-world robot data may be circumventable rather than a hard limit on robotics foundation models.
Task demonstrations performed by humans might substitute for data generated by the robot itself.
Using human video for robot learning hinges on how action labels are derived from raw footage.
Companies collecting human-task video for robotics need clear differentiation in a seemingly undifferentiated market.
Enterprise data hygiene holds enough unsolved problems to anchor a buildable hackathon-scale product.

ideas.summary: pesticide and wildfire retardant ecosystem impacts
insights: High-resolution US pesticide and fire retardant usage data can be correlated with local ecological decline.
Wildfire retardants and pesticides together may drive local ecological decline, warranting testable interaction hypotheses.
Pesticide-associated cancer increases seen in humans may also occur in animals within exposed local ecosystems.
Ecosystem-level toxicity from pesticides and fire retardants may also raise rates of specific human diseases.

ideas.main_idea: Altered membrane-protein trafficking as the cause of the Disease A phenotype
insights: In Disease A patient fibroblasts a membrane protein piles up near the nucleus instead of reaching the cell surface.
Treating 'trafficking defect' as a hypothesis to test, not a conclusion.
Need to separate slower delivery, faster internalisation, failed recycling and over-expression.
Comparing total protein with the surface fraction would rule over-expression in or out.

ideas.main_idea: Finding a functional assay, and someone to design it, for the trafficking hypothesis
insights: Nobody in the group has run a functional trafficking assay.
Needs a measurement of movement over time, not a snapshot.
Controls: a pathway block, an unaffected protein, and a check that labelling doesn't change trafficking.
Looking for a cell biologist with assay-design experience.

ideas.main_idea: Linking protein mislocalization to function in Disease A cells
insights: Mislocalization in about 60% of Disease A cells vs. 15% of controls, from imaging only.
Location alone doesn't show whether the protein's function changed.
Candidate readouts: cargo uptake, pulse-chase, surface labelling.
Unsure how to tell a real effect from an artifact of the assay itself.

ideas.main_idea: Reviewing disagreements between repeated LLM extraction runs
insights: Run each paper three times and score agreement per extracted item.
Accept items found in every run, with spot checks.
Send inconsistent items to a human reviewer and log the decisions.
Report how often the reviewer overturns the model as an error rate.
Using an LLM to pull variant-phenotype mentions out of papers for a literature review.
Two runs on the same paper return slightly different lists.
Recall looks like the weak spot: later runs miss variants.

ideas.summary: egocentric data monetization in skilled trades
insights: Skilled trades companies could collect technicians' first-person job data and turn it into scalable additional revenue streams.

ideas.summary: real-world data collection for robot learning
insights: Collecting real-world physical interaction data is a central unresolved challenge in current robotics automation.
Space technologies, conceptual and in development, can be learned as a sequence where each concept builds on fundamentals.
Conceptual grasp of key future space technologies, without deep technical detail, can support contributing to the space economy.
Comparing all leaders' speeches at identical recurring occasions can show whether distinct language proportions substantiate a party's distinctiveness.
Quantified rhetorical patterns across decades of parliamentary speeches may predict subsequent gains in party electoral support.
Economic and political returns from unexpectedly strong World Cup performance likely differ systematically across governance structures.
Claims that consultancies covertly pay political influencers can be empirically tested using only public data, without FOIA records.
If two accounts posting jointly makes a third far likelier to post than either alone, that indicates coordination.
Topic-coding posts from a fixed set of top partisan influencers could expose surprising cross-account timing coordination.
Generative AI access alone may yield little productivity; gains depend on workflow redesign and review structures within firms.
An AI optimizer iterating parametric CAD through physics simulation can refine robot structures before physical manufacturing.
AI-generated smooth, organic robot geometries may be impractical to produce with standard 3D printing or CNC machining.
Fitting friction, backlash, latency and contact parameters to real sensor logs can close the sim-to-real gap.
Hybrid analytical-plus-neural models better capture soft-material contact than traditional physics equations alone.
Calibrating simulators to physical data risks overfitting to one specific environment, undermining generalization.
Autonomous vehicle sensor logs could pretrain foundation world models later fine-tuned for robot grasping and arm motion.
Low-DOF, rolling-contact, long-range vehicle data transfers poorly to contact-rich, high-DOF, short-range manipulation.

ideas.summary: wearable human mocap for humanoid locomotion
insights: Smart insoles, IMUs and EMG worn in real environments can supply kinetic and kinematic data for bipedal robot training.
Human gait retargeted via inverse kinematics can serve as RL reference rewards, then adjusted for robot torque limits.
Muscle activation signals reveal when energy is expended versus when momentum does the work in gait.
Runs pulse-chase and surface-biotinylation assays in patient-derived fibroblasts.
Built a pH-sensitive reporter that times when a protein reaches the cell surface.
Standard control set: endocytosis block, Golgi-exit block, unaffected cargo.

ideas.main_idea: Telling real trafficking defects from imaging artifacts
insights: Fixation and antibody access can fake perinuclear accumulation.
Compare live and fixed imaging before trusting a phenotype.

ideas.main_idea: Finding disease cohorts to test the recycling assays on
insights: The assays are validated only in standard cell lines so far.
Needs patient-derived cells with a clear mislocalization phenotype.

ideas.main_idea: Automating image analysis of endosome counts
insights: Counting endosomes by hand is the slowest step in the lab.
Interested in segmentation models trained on a few labelled images.
Environmental contaminants or carcinogens may drive onset of rare glioblastoma variants such as epithelioid glioblastoma.
Regions with heavy pesticide use may show elevated incidence of rare glioblastoma variants.
Heavy fire-retardant use in wildfire-prone areas may correlate with higher glioblastoma rates, particularly among firefighters.
Haloalkane exposure may be detectable in glioma DNA through characteristic mutational signatures attributable to the chemical.
